scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed, usable with substantial friction; 10 exceptional in assessed mobile experience. Holistic judgment, not outcome-based, and not a physical-device certification.

controls.reason: Movement, two-contact fire, USE and DASH operated, but target acquisition and rapid turning were difficult; repeated overshoots and low accuracy constrained combat. Scene swipes helped after discovery.

gameplay.reason: Opening guard, route choices, receiver recovery and defensive movement provided meaningful decisions. Damage pressure during recovery and navigation left little room to learn threats. Both runs reached two memories; later progression unassessed.

presentation.reason: Strong coherent dark teal/amber visual identity, atmospheric architecture and clean title/end screens. Close walls and large relay geometry often consumed the portrait view.

usability.reason: Paused map, route line, handbook, visible fresh restart and receiver distance feedback were useful. Repeated approach corrections show that cues did not fully solve local navigation under fire.

readability.reason: Health, ammo, objective boxes, compass and terminal stats readable at 390x844. Tiny map legend/secondary type and dark crowded scene made threats and openings harder to read.

scores.holistic_reason: Promising presentation and practical planning aids offset by substantial observed aim, threat acquisition and local navigation friction. Losses themselves do not determine the grade; successful recovery and failed combat/navigation both informed it.
